title: Five Reportedly Fictitious Citations Suspected of Being AI-Generated Led to a Costs Order in a London Housing Case
summary: In a London housing case, England's High Court found that a barrister cited five reportedly fictitious cases and ordered her and the Haringey Law Centre, a legal aid charity, to pay £4,000 in wasted costs. Opposing counsel alleged AI use. The barrister denied using generative AI. The Divisional Court identified AI use as one of two possible explanations for the citations.
